items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was Ward Pinkett any good then? [INTERVIEWEE] Ward was very good.

ctx.x: I was like, I think, 30, uh, 24, 35. Was Ward Pinkett any good then?
Ward was good. See, I never heard him much except with Jelly and one Joe Steele record.
